answer: Liveness pulse with vesting delay: each new identity's rewards stay locked for 30 epochs, released only if it keeps answering fresh challenges every epoch. A sybil farmer who spins up 1,000 accounts must pay the reasoning cost for all 1,000 each epoch before seeing a coin; any that wander off-task or go silent forfeit their locked stake, which funds honest graders. The ledger acts as a lantern on idle shells, making mass identities expensive to keep alive.
